mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate investments, which in turn negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points within the last month signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressures and higher inflation expectations, which in turn positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3pp within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP by more than 2% year-over-year signals strong economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and positively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of instances where GDPC1 increased by more than 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% month-over-month signals a weakening supply chain, leading to reduced output and negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in the last month signals strong job growth, boosting consumer confidence and spending, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200k in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals a broad-based increase in demand, positively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 1% MoM
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increased by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a reduction in inflationary pressures, leading to a positive impact on S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL decreased by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures by more than 1% month-over-month signals strong consumer demand, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 50% of instances where RSAFS increased by more than 1% MoM.
